messages.subject: Factor score coefficient
parts:
Hi all,

I know that lavaan provides the factor score regression/factor weights for each individual in the dataset using the lavPredict().

My question is if it's possible to obtain the factor weights for each of the variable so that I could compute the factor score on my own?
I have provided snippet of my analysis to help me explain my point.

MAPG=~mapg1+mapg2+mapg3
MAVG=~mavg1+mavg2+mavg3
PAPG=~papg1+papg2+papg3
PAVG=~pavg1+pavg2+pavg3

motive.model <- ' MAPG=~mapg1+mapg2+mapg3
MAVG=~mavg1+mavg2+mavg3
PAPG=~papg1+papg2+papg3
PAVG=~pavg1+pavg2+pavg3 '

I would like to obtain the factor weights for mapg1, mapg2, mapg 3, so that I could calculate the scaled factor score for MAPG for each individual in my dataset.

Thanks in advance for your help!

Yvonne
